chains.frame: Which word best describes Bina’s response to the referee?

beats.text: Bina rolled her eyes at the referee and shouted, “Learn the rules before you whistle!”
beats.decisive_clue: she openly mocked the referee’s authority
beats.reason: This establishes that she openly mocked the referee’s authority.

beats.text: She made the remark loudly enough for the spectators on both sides to hear.
beats.decisive_clue: she openly mocked the referee’s authority
beats.reason: The audience intensifies the insult; the decisive point is her manner, not a reluctance to work.

chains.feedback_short: She openly mocked the referee’s authority; that detail favors insolent.
chains.feedback_deep: The audience intensifies the insult; the decisive point is her manner, not a reluctance to work. Insolent describes a disrespectful manner; indolent describes persistent avoidance of effort.
chains.contrast_rule: Insolent talks back; indolent holds back from work.

hints.attention: Examine how she addresses the referee.
hints.axis: Insolent describes a disrespectful manner; indolent describes persistent avoidance of effort.
hints.contrast: Insolent talks back; indolent holds back from work.
